request.brief: Five bespoke1080x1350 real-photo editorial pages for Nordic Log. Exact Korean wording and preserved700/450 glyph outlines. White charcoal cool gray with restrained blue footer. Every photograph is contain with original frame intact, all copy separated at least24px. Different photo geometries and reading order per page. These are different actual stock kitchens, not the same home before and after. Final native Canva export and390px QA required.
